plain.li: New place. New people. I'm writing this down so I remember what I thought on the first day, before I know better.
They gave me a bed and a bowl of something. I've had worse first days. I've had worse last days.
[winter] Arrived in the snow. Nobody asked many questions. I appreciated that.

warm.li: Everyone here looks tired and kind. I think I'll like it.

blunt.li: Day one. They need hands, I need a roof. Fair trade.

cheerful.li: First day in my new home! I've already learned everyone's name! Most of them!

gloomy.li: Another place to start over. I hope it takes longer to fall apart than the last one.

cold.li: Assessment of the colony: viable, understaffed, poorly defended. Adequate.

plain.li: Someone said we should write things down. So here I am, writing things down.
Starting a journal. If I die, at least someone will know what I thought of the rice.

warm.li: I want to remember these people. So I'm writing them down.

cheerful.li: Dear journal! Hello! We're going to be best friends!

gloomy.li: A record, for whoever finds it. Hello, whoever you are.

cold.li: Keeping records improves decisions. Beginning now.

plain.li: The council came through: {WISH}. I didn't think they'd bother. Noted.
Asked for something, got it. Writing that down because it doesn't happen often out here.
[bitter] They finally did something I asked: {WISH}. I'm not ready to forgive them. Closer, though.

warm.li: They listened. Such a small thing, and I could have cried.

blunt.li: Got what I wanted. About time.

cheerful.li: BEST DAY! The council said yes! I've been grinning at everyone like an idiot!

gloomy.li: Something went right today. I'm waiting for the catch.

cold.li: Request fulfilled. The council is more reliable than I estimated.

plain.li: They promised, and they actually did it. I'm writing it down so I remember it the next time I doubt them.
A promise kept: {WISH}. Rarer than rain in summer.

warm.li: They kept their word. I'll keep mine.

blunt.li: They said they would. They did. Good.

cheerful.li: A kept promise! I want to frame it!

gloomy.li: A promise kept. I'd almost stopped believing in those.

plain.li: Asked for something. Waited. Nothing. I'll stop asking soon.
The days ran out and nobody did anything. So that's how it is.
[repeat] Asked again. Ignored again. I'm keeping count, in here.

warm.li: I know everyone's busy. It still hurts a little.

blunt.li: Ignored. Remember that, next time they want something from me.

cheerful.li: Didn't happen! That's fine! It's fine. It's fine.

gloomy.li: Nobody came. Nobody ever really comes.

plain.li: They promised. They looked me in the eye and promised. Writing it down so I never forget the date.
A broken promise weighs more than a broken arm. I've had both now.

warm.li: I believed them. I wanted to. I don't know what I want now.

cheerful.li: So the promise didn't happen. I'm going to be cheerful about something else. Give me a minute.

gloomy.li: Of course they broke it. What else was ever going to happen?

cold.li: Promise broken. The council's word has been repriced.

plain.li: They said no. Straight to my face. At least they didn't string me along.
Refused. I'll survive. I always do.

warm.li: A clear no. I can respect that, even if I don't like it.

blunt.li: No, they said. Fine. Their loss.

cheerful.li: A no is just a yes that hasn't happened yet! I'm told that's not how it works.

gloomy.li: Told no. Somehow it's better than being ignored. Slightly.

cold.li: Request declined. Clear answers are efficient. I'll allow it.

plain.li: The council declared {DECREE}. About time somebody made a sensible decision.
Declared today: {DECREE}. Half the colony is grumbling. I'm not.

warm.li: A good decision today. I hope the others come round to it.

blunt.li: So it's {DECREE}. Finally. The complainers can complain.

cheerful.li: Wonderful news: {DECREE}! I may be the only one cheering. I'm cheering twice as loud.

gloomy.li: For once the council did what I'd have done. Unsettling.

plain.li: Now it's {DECREE}. Of course. Nobody asked me.
The council declared {DECREE} today. Counting the days until it ends.

warm.li: I'll go along with it. I won't pretend to like it.

blunt.li: Whoever came up with {DECREE} can do my share.

cheerful.li: New decree! I hate it! But in a cheerful way!

gloomy.li: Another rule to suffer under. The days get longer.

cold.li: The council declared {DECREE} against my judgment. Noted for later.

plain.li: {YEARS} year(s) here today. I've stopped thinking of anywhere else as home.
Anniversary. They remembered. I didn't think they would.

warm.li: Another year with these people. I'm lucky, and I know it.

blunt.li: Another year. Still alive. Moving on.

cheerful.li: Happy anniversary to me! Someone even said it out loud!

gloomy.li: Another year survived. The odds are catching up, I can feel it.

plain.li: They call me {TITLE} now. I pretended not to notice. I noticed.
Someone said "{TITLE}" today and meant me. I've earned that.

warm.li: They call me {TITLE}. I hope I live up to it.

blunt.li: Known as {TITLE} now. Took them long enough.

cheerful.li: I have a TITLE! They call me {TITLE}! I'm going to make everyone use it!

gloomy.li: So I'm {TITLE}. Something to carve on the headstone, I suppose.

plain.li: They've started calling me {TITLE}. I'm told it's affectionate. I'm not convinced.
I'm {TITLE} now, apparently. I didn't get a vote.

warm.li: They call me {TITLE}. Well, as long as they're smiling when they say it.

blunt.li: The next person who calls me {TITLE} gets to find out why.

cheerful.li: They call me {TITLE}! It's not a compliment! I'm taking it as one anyway!

gloomy.li: Remembered as {TITLE}. Of all the things.

plain.li: I told them I'm leaving. If anything changes in three days, it'll be the first time anything has.
Packing tonight. Not everything. Just what's mine.

warm.li: I don't want to go. Someone, please, give me a reason to stay.

cheerful.li: Leaving! New start! I'm so happy I could scream! I might be screaming!

gloomy.li: I'll probably die out there. It'll still be better than being ignored in here.

cold.li: Departure scheduled. Remaining here is no longer rational.

plain.li: They came again. We're still here. Most of us. Hands still shaking as I write this.
Another raid. I can still smell the smoke on my sleeves.
[hurt] Got hit today. It hurts to hold the pen. Writing anyway, because I can.

warm.li: Everyone looked after each other today. That's what I want to remember, not the rest.

blunt.li: They came. We shot them. Same as always.

cheerful.li: We won! I think! Everyone I like is still breathing, so: won!

gloomy.li: One day they'll win. Not today. Today we were lucky.

cold.li: Raid repelled. Losses acceptable. The perimeter needs work.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is gone. I keep starting sentences with "we should tell {OTHER_nameDef}".
Lost {OTHER_nameDef} today. Writing the name here so it's written somewhere.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef}, wherever you are: thank you. For everything. I didn't say it enough.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} died. Nothing to say that makes it better. So I won't.

cheerful.li: I can't be cheerful today. {OTHER_nameDef} would tell me to try. Tomorrow.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is dead. The world got a bit darker and nobody else seems to notice.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is dead. I find I am not as unaffected as I expected.
